_help: Empty 'departments', 'company_sizes' or 'scenarios' means 'applies to all'. 'default: true' objections are always raised first. 'resolved_when' tells the prospect what counts as a good answer, so the roleplay is consistent.

objections.text: We'll just set it up ourselves; monday.com is easy.
objections.resolved_when: The rep gives a concrete reason a partner beats DIY (time to value, rework risk, adoption, integrations expertise) or asks what they have already tried.

objections.text: monday.com already offers onboarding and support.
objections.resolved_when: The rep explains how partner work differs from generic vendor onboarding (tailored to their process, ongoing managed support, change management).

objections.text: £160 an hour is expensive. How many hours will this actually take?
objections.resolved_when: The rep gives a reasoned estimate tied to scope, or proposes scoping first, and links cost to value.

objections.text: We already tried monday.com and it didn't stick.
objections.resolved_when: The rep asks why it didn't stick and connects it to setup or adoption issues a partner would address.

objections.text: Now isn't a good time; we're mid-quarter.
objections.resolved_when: The rep respects the timing but makes a small, low-effort next step easy (a short call, a later date) or shows the cost of waiting.

objections.text: Send me an email and I'll look at it.
objections.resolved_when: The rep politely agrees but still secures a specific commitment (a short call, a time to follow up) instead of giving up.

objections.text: We're also talking to another partner.
objections.resolved_when: The rep stays calm, asks what matters in the decision, and differentiates on fit rather than trashing the competitor.

objections.text: What's the ROI and payback period?
objections.resolved_when: The rep links the cost to a figure the prospect gave (or asks for one) and offers a sensible payback reasoning without inventing guarantees.

objections.text: We're looking at HubSpot or Salesforce instead.
objections.resolved_when: The rep asks what drives the comparison and explains where monday CRM fits (flexibility, adoption, cost) without bashing the alternatives.

objections.text: Will it integrate with Jira and our dev workflow?
objections.resolved_when: The rep answers accurately about integration, and offers to scope the specific workflow rather than over-promising.

objections.text: Security and procurement will need months to approve this.
objections.resolved_when: The rep acknowledges the process, asks about it, and suggests a way to start (a pilot, early involvement of security) rather than dismissing it.

objections.text: Our IT team will want to look at it first, and they're stretched at the moment.
objections.resolved_when: The rep acknowledges the IT review, asks what it involves and how long it usually takes, and offers to make it easy (a short security summary or a call with IT) instead of dismissing it.
